name: Fatal Paws
source:
A visual novel with dark humor, turn based combat, and stat building. Experience the fatal strength in companionship and the emotional bond that can come from it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807600/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部具有黑色幽默、回合制战斗和统计构建的视觉小说。体验陪伴的致命力量以及由此产生的情感纽带。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807600/]Steam[/url]]
